title: Structure-preserving diffuse-domain accelerated saddle dynamics for wetting transitions
summary: Wetting transitions on textured substrates play a central role in the design of functional surfaces, but resolving their transition mechanisms requires efficient exploration of complex energy landscapes. In particular, saddle points are essential for revealing the connectivity among metastable states and transition pathways. In this work, we develop a diffuse-domain accelerated saddle dynamics (DD-ASD) framework for mass-constrained wetting transitions on complex textured substrates.
